title: Cryptocurrency and Digital Finance
text: Cryptocurrency is a digital or virtual currency secured by cryptography, making it nearly impossible to counterfeit or double-spend. Bitcoin, created in 2008 by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto, was the first decentralized cryptocurrency. It operates on a public blockchain, with new coins created through a process called mining. Ethereum introduced smart contracts, enabling programmable financial applications (DeFi — decentralized finance). As of 2024, there are thousands of cryptocurrencies with a combined market capitalization of several trillion dollars. Cryptocurrencies face regulatory scrutiny over their use in money laundering, their high energy consumption (for proof-of-work systems), and their price volatility.
